Liquid metal border source and adaptations

Shader: Paper Design Shaders, https://github.com/paper-design/shaders
License: Apache License 2.0, included as paper-shaders-LICENSE.txt.
The vertex and liquid-metal fragment shaders in paper-liquid-metal.js are unchanged
GLSL from the public demo below; template snippets have been expanded.

Interaction reference: Liquid Metal Button, Joly UI by Johuniq.
Copyright (c) 2025 Johuniq. MIT License, included as jolyui-LICENSE.txt.
https://www.jolyui.dev/docs/components/buttons/liquid-metal-button
https://www.jolyui.dev/r/liquid-metal-button

User-supplied public demonstration inspected on 2026-10-26:
https://cdn.21st.dev/larsen66/liquid-metal-button/demos/default/bundle.1773244704587.html

Adaptations in js/27-liquid-metal.js and metal.css: vanilla DOM integration,
existing controls and colors retained, a 2-4px rim mask, normalized shader viewport,
local-only shader loading, and a single shared renderer initialized on first hover.
Only the control under a mouse or pen animates; leaving it restores its satin rim.
Keyboard focus, touch, reduced motion, forced colors and GPU failure retain the
normal accessible controls. Rendering stops while idle or the document is hidden.
The demo's React runtime, theme loader, preview messaging and analytics are not included.
